tools.description: Full shape of one table or view: columns with types and defaults, computed definitions, indexes, and foreign keys in both directions.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

tools.description: Execute a stored procedure with bound parameters and return its recordsets, output parameters and return value. DISABLED unless SQLSERVER_EXEC_ENABLED=true. Treated as destructive for every routine: SQL Server records nothing about whether a procedure writes, so the name is not evidence. Read get_routine_definition first.

database.description: Catalog to run against. Defaults to the catalog named by the connection string.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

parameters.description: Parameter values keyed by name, without the @ prefix. Bound by the driver, never interpolated. Types are inferred from the value.

tools.title: Execute routine

tools.description: Which objects in this catalog reference objects in another catalog on the same instance, grouped by the catalog they reach into. This is the dependency graph between databases — SQL Server's three-part names are the only cross-catalog mechanism short of a linked server.

database.description: Catalog to run against. Defaults to the catalog named by the connection string.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

tools.name: find_cross_database_references
tools.title: Find cross-database references

tools.description: Full text of a stored procedure, function, view or trigger, plus its parameter contract (name, type, output, has-default). Read this before calling execute_routine.

database.description: Catalog to run against. Defaults to the catalog named by the connection string.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

includeBody.description: Include the definition text. Defaults to true.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

namePattern.description: T-SQL LIKE pattern on the object name, e.g. 'Trigger%'.

schema.description: Restrict to one schema. Omit for all schemas.

tools.title: List tables and views

tools.description: Per-column null ratio and distinct count for a table, plus its exact row count. Reads the table, so it is bounded by the same timeout as a query. distinctCount is null for types SQL Server cannot compare (xml, text, image, geography, …).

columns.description: Restrict to these columns. Defaults to all.

database.description: Catalog to run against. Defaults to the catalog named by the connection string.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

tools.name: profile_table
tools.title: Profile table

tools.description: Run one read-only T-SQL statement (SELECT, or WITH … SELECT). Three-part names (Database.dbo.Table) are allowed and are the way to join across catalogs; four-part names are refused. Pass `databases` to run the same statement across several catalogs and get results labelled per catalog.

database.description: Catalog to run against. Defaults to the catalog named by the connection string.

databases.description: Run the same statement against each of these catalogs. Mutually exclusive with `database`.

environment.description: Configured environment name. Defaults to the configured default environment.

maxRows.description: Row cap. Reaching it cancels the request, so a batch returning several recordsets is cut off at that point — `truncated: true` says so.

parameters.description: Positional parameter values, bound as @p1, @p2, … Never interpolated into the statement.

sql.description: A single SELECT / WITH … SELECT statement.

tools.name: run_read_query
tools.title: Run read query
